questions.prompt: In quadrilateral ABCD, AB = CD and AD = CB. Prove that ABCD is a parallelogram. (Draw diagonal AC.)
questions.prompt_markup: In quadrilateral ABCD, AB = CD and AD = CB. Prove that ABCD is a parallelogram. (Draw diagonal AC.)
questions.correct_answer: AB ∥ DC and AD ∥ BC, so ABCD is a parallelogram.
questions.required_method: Prove △ABC ≅ △CDA by SSS, then use the converse of the alternate interior angles theorem twice.
questions.grading_note: Any valid proof (paragraph, two-column, or flow). Essential: SSS (AB = CD, BC = DA, AC shared); ∠BAC ≅ ∠DCA, so AB ∥ DC (converse); ∠BCA ≅ ∠DAC, so BC ∥ AD; definition. Invalid: using properties of parallelograms before proving it is one.
